testCases.title: Successful page load after authentication
preconditions: User is logged in via /auth with valid email and password
steps: Confirm header displays 'Laundry' or equivalent title
testCases.expectedResult: Laundry page loads successfully with no 401/403 errors, header visible, and content area renders

testCases.title: Laundry records display with guest and room association
preconditions: At least one laundry record exists in the system
steps: Inspect a record row for guest name, room number, items, status, and charges
testCases.expectedResult: Records display correctly showing guest name, room number, laundry items, current status (e.g., Pending, In Progress, Completed), and associated charges

testCases.title: Navigation to guest detail from laundry record
preconditions: Laundry records with guest links are displayed
steps: Click on a guest name or room number within a laundry record
Verify browser navigates to the guest detail page
testCases.expectedResult: User is redirected to the guest detail page with the correct guest/room context and laundry information is visible or linked

testCases.title: Update laundry status from Pending to Completed
preconditions: A laundry record exists with status 'Pending'
steps: Click the status dropdown or update button
testCases.expectedResult: Status changes to 'Completed', page reflects the updated status, and any calculated charges are finalized

testCases.title: Empty state display when no laundry records exist
preconditions: No laundry records exist in the system
testCases.expectedResult: Page displays an empty state message (e.g., 'No laundry records found') with an option to create a new record

testCases.title: Unauthorized access to /laundry without login
testCases.expectedResult: User is redirected to /auth login page and cannot access the laundry module without valid credentials
